Lines: [Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF4500):Do you enjoy going through hell?]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF4500):You should have just died...]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):It wasn't too long ago you barely managed to defeat my doppelganger.]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):Quite the failure, wasn't it?]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):but you wield it for no one but yourself.]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):Would you like to meet my family?]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):It's absurd to even think of trying to get away.]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):As long as you live, ]][Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):[Shaking:[Scale(1.5):you will suffer.]]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):An upstart who recklessly stole and killed their way to power.]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000): I wonder, who does that remind me of...?]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):You have no stake in this battle.]]
[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):[Shaking(1.5):[Scale(1.5):No one gave you any say in this matter!]]]
[Scale(1.5):[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):Once the dust has settled and only one remains, if it is you,]]
[Colors(2, 0.5, FFA500, FF0000):[Shaking(3):[Scale(1.5):what value will this have had?!]]]
